set.q: Marcus says, “I have never lost a chess game to anyone in my club.” Bea, a member of Marcus’s club, says, “I beat Marcus in a chess game last Tuesday.” Which must be true?

why: Bea’s original line said only “a game,” not a chess game, so the two statements need not conflict and the marked answer was not strictly a ‘must be true’; specifying chess closes the loophole.
Tenacity is persistent determination and is usually a compliment, as in the sentence; ‘stubborn persistence’ adds a negative connotation the word does not carry.
The question says ‘artists,’ not painters; the label added a detail that is not in the problem.
